sections.name: summary
sections.value: Context brief. Purpose: reshape roles (req-28, s15): edit (F20), retire, merge, and F19's refusal. Entrypoints: crates/daemon/src/community/{directory,role,writer,templates}.rs, crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs (argv parser, add), crates/core/src/directory.rs (help), .dd/schemas/pij/role and the writer's schema copies (layout.rs). Order: F19 and edit first; retire and merge wait on pm-001's schema answer (C7: docs-system owns schemas); the send-path refusal waits on s05 (plan 199). Tests: scratch governance repos with the fake validator (directory_http), one real-ddocs test with a named skip; private daemon for cost. Hazards: rebase on main before the PR (lanes share crates/daemon/src/community and the CLI); biome-format each ddocs write under docs/project; shared cargo target via just shared-build.

value.title: F19: template-diff names a missing template version
value.success: template-diff on a role with meta.template and no template_version refuses with its own code, saying the role records no template version and naming `pij directory edit <id> --set template_version=<n> --why <text>`; a non-numeric version keeps E-RS-ARG with the same next step.
value.notes: community/directory.rs template_diff, where unwrap_or_default made an empty version.

value.title: F20: pij directory edit
value.success: `pij directory edit <id> --why <text>` with `--set <field>=<value>` (meta fields and the default seat and packet) and/or the role flags add takes, or `--file <json>` for the whole document. It reads the role under the writer lock, applies the change, keeps the changelog and adds one row, and commits through the writer (validate, build, commit, pointer). A missing role, a no-op edit, an unknown field or an invalid document refuses and commits nothing.
value.notes: DirectoryService gains the read-modify-write; the HTTP parser gains the edit leaf and a repeatable --set.

value.title: pij/role state fields (pending pm-001 and docs-system)
value.success: pij/role meta gains an optional state (active, retired) and merged_into; the writer's embedded schema copies refresh (C9). Waits on pm-001's answer about who writes the schema (C7).
value.notes: Proposed to pm-001 on 2026-11-06; nothing written until answered.

value.title: Retire
value.success: `pij directory retire <role> --why <text>` sets meta.state retired with a changelog row in one writer commit; refuses while a live holder holds it (and, once s05 lands, while requests are queued), naming them. The view lists it as retired with its memory, outputs and lineage intact; --json carries state.

value.title: Merge
value.success: `pij directory merge <from> --into <to> --why <text>` retires <from> with merged_into <to> and adds a changelog row to both, in one writer commit. Nothing is moved: the view lists <from> under <to> as merged-from, and both roles' memory, outputs and lineage stay readable.

value.title: Retired and merged state for the send path
value.success: A directory read that says whether a role is retired and, if merged, into what, so s05's send to a role refuses by name (naming <to> after a merge). If s05 has merged first, the send path calls it here.
value.notes: s05 (plan 199) is not on main yet; pm-001 asked.

value.title: Cost receipts
value.success: Edit, retire and merge are one writer commit each (the same launches as add), measured on a private daemon with data.pid; nothing on a timer.

value.title: Docs, skill, difficulties and states
value.success: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents edit, retire and merge and their refusals; the skill row and directory help carry them; difficulties F19 and F20 resolved; roadmap 001 gains s15 (delivers req-28, depends on s04, plan cell, complete); req-28 shipped; the PR body has a Delivers line.
